rules.def: unicodedata NFKC normalization of the formula string
rules.name: nfkc

rules.def: superscript digits mapped to caret form via fixed table (11 entries)
rules.name: superscript_transcribe

rules.def: greek letters mapped to latin names via fixed table (33 entries); same table applied to si_units keys
rules.name: greek_transcribe

rules.def: whitespace runs collapsed to single space, strip both ends
rules.name: ws_collapse

rules.def: formula with >1 equation separator, no banned comparison operator and no statement markers (set-builder/quantifier/logic-connective characters) is split into consecutive pairs (a=b=c -> a=b, b=c); product ids append _p<k>; multi-'=' formulas carrying statement markers are routed out by R13 instead (non-chain form)
rules.name: chain_split

rules.def: insert '*' at lexical boundaries only: a maximal number token (digit run not preceded by an identifier character) followed by an identifier-start letter, or ')' followed by identifier/digit/'('; identifier tokens are never split (t2g/H2O/x2 intact); skipped when the letter run is a scientific-notation exponent (e.g. 1e5, 1E-10)
rules.name: implicit_mult_insert

rules.def: symbols object keys = ordered union of formula identifiers and valid source symbol names (^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$); values from source symbol descriptions when available else empty string; source names that are not bare identifiers are recorded as dropped, never invented
rules.name: symbols_rebuild

rules.def: max_version_depth=1, monotone_form=true (uniform finiteness/monotone declarations); metadata.source = source citation when the source provides one, else 'pending-citation:<id>' (flagged source_status=pending for the citation-completion stage)
rules.name: uniform_declarations

rules.def: pool entries whose normalized formula still contains a banned comparison operator (!=, <=, >=) or has no equation separator are not equation-identity laws: they are excluded to a documented side-list (rule_set semantics), never rewritten
rules.name: non_identity_routing
